Package com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.out.rail.channels

Class FailClosedChannelsMeshInjectGateway

java.lang.Object
com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.out.rail.channels.FailClosedChannelsMeshInjectGateway
All Implemented Interfaces:
ChannelsMeshInjectGateway
public class FailClosedChannelsMeshInjectGateway extends Object implements ChannelsMeshInjectGateway
Honest stub: CHANNELS→LND inject is not wired.

Refuse channel opens that would treat empty/unrelated LND wallet funds as mesh CHANNELS capital. See VAULT_MESH_PLAN.md Gaps and docs/backend/INFRASTRUCTURE.md.
